_about: When one task ends and the next one begins.
Measured through the real TaskSessionStore, one held problem and one
turn at a time, because that is the whole decision: about_the_same_thing
is asked once per turn and everything downstream -- candidates,
constraints, evidence, the search query -- follows whatever it says.
Both directions are in here on purpose, and the continue half is the
half that matters. Splitting too eagerly loses three turns of
established context and is the failure the whole branch exists to
prevent; a case list of only the splits would score 100% on a function
open        the task already open: what was said, and the subject the
turn        the turn under test, with the router's own two flags
expect      continue = the same task; split = a new one
why         the conversation this came from, or the rule it holds
